workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes HF0 interface preparation after source-only fixture smoke and selects next branch

route to bounded source-only pilot implementation only if it adds closed-loop or backend evidence
stop external backend work until dependencies are available if required

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2486 is branch synthesis and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.

self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2477 through M2485 HF0 interface preparation evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If synthesis finds no driver evidence gain, state that plainly and pivot to an evidence-producing route.
allowed_claims: no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A post-smoke branch synthesis can prevent HF0 interface preparation from becoming another infrastructure loop and select the next evidence-producing route.
success_criteria: synthesis answers evidence_summary supported_claims falsified_claims failure_taxonomy_summary public_gate_overfit_risk next_branch_decision
synthesis distinguishes infrastructure progress from driver capability evidence
synthesis registers a bounded follow-up milestone
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2486 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2486 changes actor input or action contract
M2486 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2486 treats canned source-only smoke as policy performance
M2486 ranks controller families or selects a winner

decision_rule: M2486 passes if it synthesizes HF0 interface preparation evidence after source-only smoke and chooses a bounded next route without external simulation, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
